acceptance_results.criterion: INCREMENT 2026-10-06. The negative control is skipped only when the decision step writes skip=true, which it does only after computing `git diff --no-renames --name-only <base.sha> HEAD` and finding no path matching DB_SURFACE; an empty or missing base, a failed diff, a grep error, any surface path (including a deletion or a move off the surface) and every push to main run it. The decision step never fails the job, and the job carries no job-level condition.

INCREMENT 2026-10-06. Every repository path the negative control reads, measured by walking the Makefile DB entry point, its import graph and the literal paths those modules and the two database steps name, matches DB_SURFACE; npm run check fails otherwise.
INCREMENT 2026-10-06. Straight after the checkout, the job fails unless git rev-parse HEAD equals github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha, and fails on an empty expectation.

INCREMENT 2026-10-08. On a pull request the job prints `records-only classifier: RECORDS-ONLY` only when the base's classifier exited 0 on <base.sha>..HEAD and its first line begins `records-only: `; every other case -- a base branch that is not exactly `main`, an empty or missing base commit, a base holding no readable classifier, a classifier exit 1, or any other exit (2 for a diff or blob git could not read) -- prints `NOT RECORDS-ONLY` with the reason. The step always exits 0, writes no GITHUB_OUTPUT/GITHUB_ENV/GITHUB_PATH, has no id, and runs before npm ci and npm run check; the pull request's own copy of the classifier is never its judge.

migration_and_data_impact: None. No schema, migration, provider call, credential or customer-data effect; Gate G0 forbids all of them and this package changed none.
compatibility_impact: CI change. The bootstrap job keeps its name and its required check context. One step is added, on pull_request events only, after "Verify pinned toolchain" and before "Clean install": it prints the base classifier's records-only verdict to the log (inside a ::stop-commands:: window with a random token) and to the job summary (escaped, at most 64 KiB of output).
